description: tranzy.ai, a private urban mobility company, publishes public transport open data for several cities in Romania and Moldova on behalf of municipalities and operators. The open data page read on 2026-09-28 sets out its policy, based on the Open Definition (free use, reuse and redistribution with at most attribution and share-alike), separates public open datasets from processed private datasets offered through challenges, and shows a live map built only from the public feeds for Iași, Cluj-Napoca, Constanța, Chișinău and Botoșani; users obtain an API key to access the data feeds. Coverage is those five cities' bus, tram and trolleybus networks. Access is free with an API key; the exact licence and formats of the feeds are not named on the page. Caveats: feed content (schedules, stops, real-time positions) was inferred from the live map, and the service depends on a private company. It supports public transport network models and agent-based mobility simulation for mid-sized Romanian cities and Chișinău, such as disruption of tram lines. No related Romanian public transport record is catalogued.
